variants.headline: Looking back: party names a new leader
variants.sub: Leadership of a political party has changed in the colony.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: A party had a new leader in {colony}.

Labour has reason to pay attention to a new party leader, without assuming that a different face means a different life for workers. Wages, safety and household needs remain the useful yardstick. A political organisation should be judged by how seriously it takes those matters, whoever speaks for it.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

This paper approaches {target} without a verdict supplied by the fact of replacement. Leadership has changed; the merits of conduct and proposals require their own assessment on an adequate record.
